facts.text: I have been traveling a lot lately.
I am trying to get a better sense of my expenses.
I want help tracking my travel costs for flights and transportation from the airport to my accommodations.
In the past month, I flew from New York to Los Angeles two times for work.
The flights cost around $500 each.
The total flight cost for the two New York to Los Angeles work trips was around $1000.
On the first New York to Los Angeles trip, I took an Uber from the airport to my hotel.
The Uber from the airport to my hotel cost around $60.
On the second New York to Los Angeles trip, I used the hotel's shuttle service.
The hotel's shuttle service on the second trip was free.
I want to use a spreadsheet to track my expenses.
I already use Google Drive.
I want to set up and access the spreadsheet from anywhere using Google Drive.
I want to track my accommodation costs because I have been staying at a lot of hotels lately.
My accommodation costs were around $200 per night for 3 nights on each trip.
My accommodation costs were around $600 per trip.
I want to track food and activity expenses as well.
I am planning a trip to Chicago for a business meeting soon.
I will be flying from New York for the Chicago business meeting trip.
I am not sure about the accommodations yet for the Chicago trip.
I think I spent around $80-100 per day on food and activities during my LAX trips.
My food and activity spending during each LAX trip was around $240-300 per trip.
